title: Momoi Airi — Sweet Moment〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, Airi! Order anything you like!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure, thanks...
But you're really okay with paying?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. You're the one who helped me find my answer, so think of this as a token of my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You don't have to do all this, you know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Well, I guess she does seem to be having fun. Plus, I can't pass up an opportunity to enjoy this Japanese sweets fair.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then I guess I'll have to take you up on your offer. But they all look so good... I don't know which one to get.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
In that case, we can just get one of each?
Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, hold on! There's no way the two of us can eat that many!
Oh, sorry about that! Could we have just a moment please?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, these look delicious!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They sure do. Mmm... I haven't had anmitsu in quite some time. It's delicious.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This matcha parfait is really good too.
Wanna try some?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Sure. Here, you can have some of mine too.
And try this warabimochi parfait as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We ended up getting a lot but it looks like we won't have any trouble finishing it all.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi. There's something that's been bothering me for a while.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What's that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You compared me to a swan before that one time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember...
What about it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If I'm a swan, I was wondering what animal you would be. I've been thinking about it for some time, but I just can't seem to find the perfect fit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The perfect animal, huh? Wasn't there some fortunetelling thing that matches you to an animal?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there was. But I can't remember where I saw it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm sure a quick search will tell us.
Now where'd my phone go?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, here it is!
How about we both give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... That took longer than I expected!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously... How does it take you ten whole minutes to answer a few simple questions?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, what animal did you get?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see. It says here I'm a rhinoceros.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A rhinoceros?! Definitely not what I would've gone with, but what does it say about you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... As a rhinoceros, you are a hard worker whose strong desire to improve yourself drives you towards achieving your goals.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh. I see... That's actually pretty on the nose.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, when you have no interest in something, it shows on the surface, and you also tend to bumble around carelessly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Furthermore, you know exactly what you like or dislike and have a strongly fixate on the things you like.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-I didn't realize...
Is this the real me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No! There's no way...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You don't think so? What does yours say, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It says that I'm a lion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a great animal.
They're so strong but fluffy too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess they are cats after all, so they're not completely lacking for cuteness.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... As a lion, your strong sense of justice makes you a natural leader. You also have a strong, rebellious spirit and are unbending in terms of what you believe in.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Furthermore, you also take great care when it comes to your outward appearance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow! That's very accurate!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess so.
There's still more.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, your unyielding personality negatively affects your ability to flourish in the real world.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: An inability to compromise with others means you will have great difficulty succeeding in the workplace.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You also tend to set your expectations too high, so it may be best to reassess your goals in life.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Try your best to strive for something realistic and reachable...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Airi, please calm down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I-I am calm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku's was way off, so why is it that mine is actually somewhat accurate? This isn't funny.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There were a few questions that I wasn't sure how to answer, so maybe we can try again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, what's so funny?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You just reminded me of when we were idols-in-training. Do you remember that time we all went to visit the shrine during New Year's?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You got a fortune that said, great curse, so you kept pulling new ones until you got one that said, great blessing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
H-Hey!
Why do you remember stuff like that?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just forget about that, will you? It's definitely not something I want to remember.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? I admire how you're never dissuaded and always try to push forward, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I thought I could learn a lot by following your example.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If that's what you want to do, then be my guest.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will! In that case, I think I'll take the quiz one more time as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This time, I'll do my best to get something that matches perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the example you're going to follow? And it's not really a fortune if you manipulate it to make it match...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Whatever. As long as she's having fun, I guess...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi. It looks like I won some sort of raffle.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It says, You're today's lucky winner! Answer a few easy questions and get a free appliance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What?! W-Wait, Shizuku!
That's definitely just a scam!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see. Do I just tap here and...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
STOP! I just said that's a scam!
Quick, get away from that site!
